newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North sees flat ERA earnings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North sees flat ERA earnings.

text.p: North Ltd said on Thursday it expected flat earnings from its 68 percent-owned uranium miner Energy Resources of Australia Ltd (ERA) this year.
North managing director Campbell Anderson said uranium oxide sales would be flat or a little down on last year and this would be only broadly offset by any price improvement.
"So I see reasonably flat earnings from ERA this year but thereafter, with the increased production and increased sales, ... I would see a signficant increase after that," Anderson told reporters.

ERA said said earlier this month its production outlook was the brightest it had been for 15 years and that the recent rise in international uranium oxide prices would allow the company to proceed with new capital investment.
ERA's net profit soared to A$40.73 million in 1995/96 from A$12.37 million in 1994/95.
